description: Visual regression: save a named baseline (viewport, element, or a PNG such as the design mockup) and compare later — changed-pixel % and a red-highlighted diff; or compare_urls: production vs staging in this tab, pixels plus text diff, logged-in pages included. Baselines are in-memory (lost on service worker restart).

action.description: baseline stores, compare measures against it, compare_urls diffs url_a vs url_b here, clear drops baselines

from_file.description: action=baseline: take it from this PNG (design mockup) instead of capturing

mask.description: compare_urls: selectors hidden on both pages (dates, carousels, ads)

name.description: Baseline id: reuse the same one to compare across runs

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

url_b.description: compare_urls: page under test, e.g. staging or a PR preview

name: screenshot_diff
